cal_001.name: Push-up ya Lebota
instructions: Ema ka bolelele ba letsoho ho tloha leboteng, maoto hammoho.
Beha liatla leboteng bophahamong ba mahetla, matsoho a sephara ho feta mahetla.
'Mele o otlolohile ho tloha hloohong ho ea ho lirethe (mahare a mantlha).
Hohella, koba litsoele ho fihlela sefuba se batla se ama lebota (2-3 s).
Exhale, sutumelletsa morao ho qala (1-2 s).
Boloka lirethe fatše nako eohle.

cal_002.name: Iketsetse Push-up
instructions: Matsoho a lehlakoreng la counter, matsoho tlas'a mahetla.
Tsamaea maoto morao e le hore 'mele o be mola o otlolohileng hlooho-to-heel.
Li-core tight, glutes tse petelitsoeng.
Sefubeng se ka tlase ho ea ho counter (matsoho a 45 ° ho tloha 'meleng).
Tobetsa bekapo e notletsoe ka botlalo.
Bonolo = holimo holimo; thata = tafole e tlase.

audio.execution: Li-core tight, glutes tse petelitsoeng. Sefubeng se ka tlase ho ea ho counter (matsoho a 45 ° ho tloha 'meleng).

cal_003.name: Knee Push-up
instructions: Qala ka tsohle-nne, matsoho a batla a le bophara ho feta mahetla.
Tsamaea ka mangole morao e le hore 'mele o otlolohe ho tloha hloohong ho ea mangoleng.
Lithapo tsa maoto (kapa u boloke likhoele tsa lieta li bataletse haeba fatše ho le bohloko).
Sefubeng se ka tlaase ho fihlela 5 cm ka holim'a fatše.
Sutumelletsa morao ho matsoho a otlolohileng.
Boloka letheka le mahetleng - ha ho "noha" holimo.

cal_004.name: Hip Hinge Drill (Good Morning)
instructions: Ema maoto ka bophara ba letheka, matsoho holim'a letheka.
Mangole a bonolo, sefuba se motlotlo.
Sutumelletsa letheka morao (nahana ka ho koala lemati la koloi).
Utloa hamstrings otlolla; ema ha mmele wa mmele o le haufi le ho bapelana le fatshe.
Khanna letheka ho ea pele ho ema - U SE KE UA kgutlela morao.
Motsamao o tsoa lethekeng, eseng ho kobeha thekeng.

cal_005.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Robala ka mokokotlo, mangole a kobehile 90 °, maoto a bophara ba letheka.
Matsoho a matsoho a holimo ho 45 ° bakeng sa botsitso.
Sekama pelvis hanyenyane (batalatsa tlase-morao fatše).
Squeeze glutes, phahamisa letheka ho fihlela mola o otlolohileng mangole-mahetleng.
Tšoara 1 s holimo-mangole a lule a le moleng (ha ho na flop-out).
Tlase tlas'a taolo; hanyenyane ama fatše 'me u tsamaee hape.

cal_006.name: Glute Bridge ea leoto le le leng
instructions: Ho hlophisoa ho tšoanang, empa otlolla leoto le le leng ho ea siling.
Sututsa ka serethe sa leoto le theohileng.
Phahamisa letheka ka ho lekana-u se ke ua lumella pelvis hore e theohe ka lehlakoreng la leoto la mahala.
8-12 reps, ebe u fetola.
Ho sisinyeha haholo? Boloka leoto le phahamisitsoeng le kobehile ho 90°.

cal_007.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Ka morao a bataletse leboteng, maoto a 30-40 cm ka pele.
Thellela fatše ho fihlela mangole a 90 ° (lirope li bapile le fatše).
Maqaqailana ka ho toba tlas'a mangole, maoto a bophara ba mahetla.
Matsoho a lirope kapa a tšekaletseng sefubeng—ho se na ho sututsana ka matsoho.
Phefumoloha ka mokhoa o tloaelehileng; boloka nako e behiloeng.
Qetella ka ho thellela holimo, eseng ho thella.

cal_008.name: Static Lunge Hold
instructions: Tsamaea pele ka mokhoa o molelele; serethe se ka morao.
Tlosa lengole le ka morao ho fihlela mangole ka bobeli ~ 90 °.
Torso e otlolohile, e tiileng haholo.
Khutsa feela; tobetsa serethe se ka pele fatshe ho boloka tsitsipano.
Fetola maoto sete e latelang.
Lengole ha lea lokela ho feta menoana ea maoto-haeba ho le joalo, nka mohato o molelele.

cal_009.name: Phahamisa Namane
instructions: Ema fatše, maoto a letheka-bophara, matsoho hanyenyane a ama lebota bakeng sa ho leka-lekana.
Ema holim'a libolo tsa maoto ka hohle kamoo ho ka khonehang (hatella).
Emisa 1s hodimo.
Fokotsa butle 2-3 s ho fihlela lirethe li ama fatše.
Mangole a otlolohile ho otla gastrocnemius.

cal_010.name: Phahamisa Namane ea Leoto le Leng
instructions: Boemo bo tšoanang, empa tšela leoto le sa lefelloeng ka mor'a leqaqailaneng.
Fetolela boima ba 'mele ho ea ho leoto le emeng.
Sebelisa menoana e 'meli leboteng feela bakeng sa ho leka-lekanya, eseng ho hula.
Lethathamo le felletseng: serethe se ka tlase ho boemo ba mokato haeba u khona, ebe u nyolohela holimo.
Etsa li-reps tsohle ka lehlakoreng le le leng, ebe u fetola.

cal_011.name: Dead-bug
instructions: Robala ka mokokotlo, matsoho a otlolohile siling, mangole holim'a letheka (boemo ba 90-90).
Batalatsa ka tlase ho mokatong (nahana ka ho phunya kokoanyana).
Fokotsa butle letsoho le MOJALO ka holim'a hlooho 'me leoto le LEFT ka ntle ho fihlela serethe se batla se thetsana.
Lula u khomaretse fatše-haeba e le mahlakoreng, khutsufatsa sebaka.

cal_013.name: Tloaelehileng Push-up
instructions: Qala lepolanka matsohong, matsoho tlas'a mahetla, maoto hammoho.
'Mele o otlolohileng ear-leqaqailaneng; squeeze glutes, brace core.
Li-elbows 45 ° ho tloha torso, sefubeng se ka tlase ho 5 cm ka holim'a fatše (2-3 s).
Tobetsa morao ho fihlela matsoho a otlolohile; boloka letheka ka moleng-ha ho na ho sisinyeha.
Phefumoloha fatše, tsoa holimo.

cal_014.name: Squat e haufi-ufi
instructions: Ema maoto ka bophara ba noka, menoana ka ntle hanyane.
Matsoho a lethekeng kapa a mathela sefubeng.
Roba letheka pele, ebe mangole; dula fatshe ho fihlela dirope di bapile le fatshe.
Tsela ea mangole holim'a monoana oa bobeli; sefuba motlotlo.
Khanna ka leoto lohle ho ema; pepeta glutes hodimo.

cal_015.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Tsoela pele ka tsela e telele.
Tlosa lengole le ka morao ho fihlela mangole ka bobeli ~ 90 °.
Sututsa ka serethe se ka pele ho khutlisetsa leoto pele mohatong o latelang.
Boloka torso e otlolohile, bohareng bo tiileng.
Maoto a mang bakeng sa li-reps tse lakatsehang.

instructions: Qala ka tlaase ho squat (lirope li bapile).

Naha ka bonolo bohareng ba leoto, hang-hang teba hape ka squat (ho lula ho khutsitse).
Seta hape haeba foromo e robeha; emisa haeba mangole a thinyetsa ka hare.

instructions: Ema ka bolelele, maoto hammoho, matsoho ka mahlakoreng.
Theohela ho quarter-squat, suthela matsoho morao.
Phahloha holimo, o atolose maoto ho feta mahetla 'me u phahamise matsoho ho etsa "X" moeeng.
Fana ka bonolo maoto hammoho, matsoho a khutlela ka mahlakoreng.

cal_018.name: Mountain Climber (ka potlako)
instructions: Qala ka lepolanka, matsoho tlas'a mahetla, 'mele o otlolohile.

cal_022.name: V-up
instructions: Robala fatše, matsoho holimo, maoto a otlolohile.
Ka nako e le 'ngoe phahamisa' torso le maoto, u fihlele matsoho maotong.

Ka bonolo reketla pele le morao joalo ka setulo se sisinyehang, se bolokang sebopeho.

Ha u ntse u boloka mokokotlo o otlolohile ka hohle kamoo ho ka khonehang, khumama ka mangole, khumama ka pele 'me u tšoare bar u sebelisa sehare (bophara ba mahetla) ho tšoara ka letsoho. Ena e tla ba sebaka sa ho qala boikoetliso. Keletso: Haeba ho le thata ho ts'oara bareng ka mokhoa ona, fetola letsoho la hau kapa sebelisa likhoele tsa letsoho.

Ha u ntse u tšoere bar, qala ho phahamisa ka ho sutumetsa ka maoto a hao ha ka nako e le 'ngoe u isa torso ea hau sebakeng se otlolohileng ha u ntse u phefumoloha. Ha u le boemong bo otlolohileng, hlahisa sefuba sa hau ka ntle 'me u koale mokokotlo ka ho khutlisetsa mahetla morao. Nahana kamoo masole a sesole a shebahalang kateng ha a eme a shebile.

Khutlela sebakeng sa ho qala ka ho khumama ka mangole ha ka nako e le 'ngoe u itšetlehile ka torso ka pele thekeng ha u ntse u boloka mokokotlo o otlolohile. Ha litekanyo tse holim'a bar li ama fatše u khutlela sebakeng sa ho qala 'me u itokiselitse ho pheta-pheta hape.
Etsa palo ea ho pheta-pheta e behiloeng lenaneong.

fed_barbell_full_squat.name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Boikoetliso bona bo etsoa hantle ka har'a rack ea squat molemong oa polokeho. Ho qala, qala ka ho beha bar holim'a rack e ka holimo ho lehetla. Hang ha bophahamo bo nepahetseng bo khethiloe 'me bar e laetsoe, hata ka tlas'a bar' me u behe ka morao mahetleng a hao (hanyenyane ka tlas'a molala) ho pholletsa le eona.
Tšoara bareng u sebelisa matsoho ka bobeli lehlakoreng le leng le le leng 'me u le phahamise holim'a rack ka ho qala ka ho sutumetsa ka maoto a hao' me ka nako e ts'oanang u otlolle torso ea hau.

Tloha ho tloha rack 'me u behe maoto a hao u sebelisa boemo bo mahareng bo bophara ba mahetla 'me menoana e totobalitse hanyenyane. Boloka hlooho ea hau holimo ka linako tsohle 'me u lule u otlolohile mokokotlong. Sena e tla ba sebaka sa hau sa ho qala.

Qala ho theola sekhahla butle ka ho khumama mangole 'me u lule morao ka letheka ha u ntse u boloka boemo bo otlolohileng ka hlooho. Tsoela pele ho fihlela li-hamstrings li le holim'a manamane a hau. Inhale ha u ntse u etsa karolo ena ea motsamao.
Qala ho phahamisa bar ha u ntse u phefumoloha ka ho sutumetsa fatše ka serethe kapa bohareng ba leoto la hao ha u ntse u otlolla maoto le ho atolosa letheka ho khutlela sebakeng sa ho qala.
Pheta bakeng sa palo e khothalletsoang ea ho pheta-pheta.

instructions: Robala fatše ka matsoho a hau haufi le mahlakore a hau.

fed_clean_and_press.name: Hloekisa le ho Tobetsa
instructions: Nka boemo ba bophara ba mahetla, ka mangole ka har'a matsoho. Hona joale ha u ntse u boloka mokokotlo o bataletse, o khumama ka mangole le lethekeng e le hore u ka tšoara bar ka matsoho a atolositsoeng ka ho feletseng le ho ts'oaroa ha pronated ho feta bophara ba mahetla. Supa litsoe ka mahlakoreng. The bar e lokela ho ba haufi le shins. Beha mahetla ka holim'a bar kapa ka pele hanyane. Theha boemo ba mokokotlo o bataletseng. Sena e tla ba sebaka sa hau sa ho qala.

Qala ho hula bar ka ho atolosa mangole. Tsamaisa letheka la hao pele 'me u phahamise mahetla ka lebelo le le leng ha u ntse u boloka lehlakoreng la mokokotlo le sa khaotse; tsoela pele ho phahamisa bar ka ho toba ha u ntse u e boloka haufi le 'mele oa hau.

Ha bar e feta lengole, fetela maqaqailaneng, mangole le letheka ka matla, ho tšoana le ho qhoma. Ha u ntse u etsa joalo, tsoela pele ho tataisa bar ka matsoho a hao, u sisinyeha mahetleng 'me u sebelise matla a tsoang ho mokhatlo oa hau ho hula bar ka hohle kamoo ho ka khonehang. The bar e lokela ho tsamaea haufi le 'mele oa hau,' me u lokela ho boloka likhapha tsa hau li le ka ntle.

Ha u le boemong bo phahameng ka ho fetisisa, maoto a hao a lokela ho hlakola fatše 'me u lokela ho qala ho hula ka tlas'a bar. Mechine ea sena e ka fetoha hanyane, ho latela boima bo sebelisitsoeng. U lokela ho theohela sebakeng sa squatting ha u ntse u hula ka tlas'a bar.

Ema ho fihlela bophahamo bo feletseng, u tšoere bar sebakeng se hloekileng.

Ka mor'a ho atolosoa ka ho feletseng, khutlisetsa letheka le mangole ho amohela boima ba 'mele sebakeng sa squat. Lumella matsoho hore a khumame, a tataise li-dumbbells mahetleng a hao.

fed_lying_machine_squat.name: Leshano Machine Squat
instructions: Fetola mochine oa leoto ho ea bophahamong bo tla u lumella ho kena ka hare ho oona ka mangole a kobehileng le lirope hanyenyane ka tlase ho bapisa.

Hang ha u khetha boima ba 'mele, ipehe ka har'a mochine u shebane le mangole a kobehileng le lirope hanyenyane ka tlase ho bapa le sethala. Etsa bonnete ba hore mangole ha a fete menoaneng. Lehlakore le entsoeng pakeng tsa hamstrings le manamane e lokela ho ba e 'ngoe e ka tlaase ho likhato tse 90 (kaha boemo ba hau ba ho qala bo hloka hore u qale hanyenyane ka tlase ho bapisa). Mokokotlo oa hau le hlooho ea hau li lokela ho phomola mochine ha mahetla a hao a hatelloa tlas'a mekotla ea mahetla.
Beha matsoho a hau ka lihapi 'me u behe maoto a hao hanyenyane a lebile sebakeng sa bophara ba mahetla. Sena e tla ba sebaka sa hau sa ho qala.

Pheta bakeng sa palo e khothalletsoang ea ho pheta-pheta.

instructions: Ema u otlolohile 'mele oa hau o otlolohile' me u tšoere dumbbell letsohong le leng le le leng ka bolelele ba matsoho. Li-elbows li lokela ho ba haufi le torso.
Etsa bonnete ba hore liatla tsa matsoho li shebane. Sena e tla ba sebaka sa hau sa ho qala.

Ha u ntse u tšoere letsoho le ka holimo le eme, kobeha litšepe ha u ntse u hokela li-biceps ha u ntse u hema. Ke liphatla feela tse lokelang ho tsamaea. Letsoho la hao le lokela ho potoloha e le hore u ka tšoara liatla holimo. Tsoela pele ho sisinyeha ho fihlela li-biceps li kenngoa ka ho feletseng 'me li-dumbbells li le mahetleng.
Tšoara boemo ba konteraka motsotsoana ha u ntse u petetsa li-biceps.
Hona joale nakong ea boemo ba konteraka, potoloha letsoho la hao ho fihlela joale u e-na le "limpatla tse shebileng fatše) tse tšoarellang ka monoana o motona sebakeng se phahameng ho feta pinky.
Butle-butle qala ho khutlisetsa li-dumbbells fatše u sebelisa mokhoa o hlalositsoeng.
Ha li-dumbbell li koala lirope tsa hau, qala ho potoloha letsoho e le hore u khutlele ho se nke lehlakore (lipama tse shebaneng le 'mele oa hau).
Pheta bakeng sa palo e khothalletsoang ea ho pheta-pheta.

fed_zottman_preacher_curl.name: Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Tšoara li-dumbbell letsohong le leng le le leng 'me u behe matsoho a hao a ka holimo holim'a benche ea baboleli kapa benche e tšekaletseng. Li-dumbbells li lokela ho ts'oaroa ka bophahamo ba mahetla 'me likhahla li lokela ho kobeha. Tšoara li-dumbbells ka liatla tsa matsoho a hao li shebile fatše. Sena e tla ba sebaka sa hau sa ho qala.
Ha u ntse u phefumoloha, theola li-dumbbells butle-butle u boloke liatla fatše ho fihlela letsoho la hao le ka holimo le atolosoa 'me li-biceps tsa hao li otlolohile ka ho feletseng.
Joale fetola matsoho a hau hang ha u le tlase ho motsamao e le hore liatla tsa matsoho li shebane holimo.

Ha u ntse u phefumoloha, sebelisa li-biceps tsa hau ho koala litekanyo ho fihlela li kentsoe ka ho feletseng 'me li-dumbbells li le bophahamong ba mahetla. Hape, hopola hore ho etsa bonnete ba hore ho koeteloa ka ho feletseng u hloka ho tlisa monoana o monyenyane holimo ho feta monoana o motona.
Petetsa li-biceps ka thata motsotsoana sebakeng se kontetsoeng 'me u fetole matsoho a hao hore liatla li shebane fatše hape.
Pheta bakeng sa palo e khothalletsoang ea ho pheta-pheta.
